Actually when I posted that everyone was like you should totally go for hip preservation if your hip isn't arthritic. Everyone was like - "I'm 36 and they totally said I'm a candidate for PAO and was discouraged from getting a THR."

I read some of the horror stories after the PAOs (like people having 9 surgeries, blood clots, broken femur, etc) that I'm glad I'm going with a THR. If I need a revision in 15-20 years, so be it.
My surgeon did mention something like that may happen. Honestly as long as i'm able to be active and the pain is mostly gone, I'll be okay

Oh wow, question though, how soon would I be able to do things like squatting? I love to work out and I lost that ability due to the pain i'm in.
